execution_requirements.replay_command: acquire the NIST-JARVIS OPTIMADE endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

falsifier_requirement.trigger: hidden JARVIS target property appears in visible descriptors; official JARVIS snapshot hash is missing or changes; composition-family median comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty; fewer than 20 material/property targets are scored

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Predict hidden property = fixed linear ridge map of visible composition counts, element summary descriptors, density, dimensionality, and space-group number.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Predict each hidden property using the visible-row median for the same element-count family; fall back to global visible median.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Implement or repair the exact domain scorer until the downstream scoring artifact passes or remains honestly fail-closed with a narrower research blocker.

required_source_block.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
required_source_block.source_name: NIST-JARVIS JARVIS-DFT OPTIMADE structures and materials-property records

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual per material/property plus aggregate MAE over hidden targets
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: descriptor model MAE plus bootstrap upper margin must be lower than the composition-family median comparator

target_variable.name: elastic_stiffness_and_bandgap_material_property
target_variable.unit: GPa for moduli; eV for bandgap

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual per material/property plus aggregate MAE over hidden targets
uncertainty_requirement.rule: visible-row bootstrap interval declared before hidden property fields are unsealed

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
